summary.intent: Skip the discuss-phase ceremony for phase 50 (two captured bug-fix todos) by locking in the on-demand traversal approach for #14, then kick off plan-phase with that decision.
summary.outcome: Locked decision recorded and CONTEXT.md synthesized and committed for phase 50; plan-phase workflow initiated but planning/research/verification not yet complete (transcript ends at CONTEXT.md commit).

repo: Phase 50 scope is exactly two todos: #12 (phase 42 unpin integrity review findings) and #14 (unenroll skips unloaded subtrees during deletion).
WR-01 bug: passing INT_MIN through abs() in hashtext produces integer out of range, making the CID permanently undeletable — one-line fix to drop the abs() call.
WR-03 bug: re-pinning a CID during outbox drain then calling unpin triggers GC and data loss — fix is to snapshot pinned_cids count before draining and skip re-pinned CIDs.
The #14 on-demand traversal approach: during deletion, fetch and decrypt persisted child folder metadata to collect the full descendant IPNS name set, rather than relying on the in-memory folderTree.
The reconciliation-job backstop for orphaned IPNS records remains in BACKLOG but was explicitly not chosen for phase 50.

code.finding: Contains root cause, exact patch, and acceptance criteria for ~13 WR/IN findings; WR-01 and WR-03 are high-severity; remaining items are medium/low and need fix-or-accept triage in planning.
Documents the fork between on-demand traversal vs. reconciliation-job backstop; on-demand was chosen to guarantee complete cleanup at delete time.

workflow: When discuss-phase is deliberately skipped but a locked decision exists, synthesize a CONTEXT.md manually (with trackable decision IDs) so the plan-phase decision-coverage gate works correctly.
The gsd plan-phase workflow supports express paths (--prd, --ingest, locked decision from context) that bypass discuss-phase; CONTEXT.md acts as the canonical decision record for downstream gates.
phase 50 was already gateable (status: Pending, no blocking conditions) so no gate-clearing was needed before planning could start.

friction: The gsd workflow has no first-class 'skip discuss-phase with inline decision' flag — the workaround is synthesizing CONTEXT.md manually before spawning the planner, which is an extra step not surfaced in the standard flow.
open_items: Planning not yet complete: research, PLAN.md generation, and verification loop still pending after CONTEXT.md commit.
Medium/low WR/IN findings from 42-REVIEW.md (beyond WR-01 and WR-03) need explicit fix-or-accept triage during plan-phase.
Reconciliation-job backstop for orphaned IPNS records deferred to BACKLOG — will eventually be needed for records that escape the on-demand traversal path.
